description: Land Acquisition - Madawalamulla North, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that a specific parcel of land (Dinginaidegewatta) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed land descriptions including extent, location, boundaries, and survey information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. Although a government minister is named, the primary focus and substance of the notice is the acquisition of land, not the minister's appointment or portfolio responsibilities.
